name: Extra Enhanced Familiar
body:
Your connection to your familiar grants it greater power.

Prerequisite(s): Enhanced Familiar class feature

Benefit(s): You gain an additional enhanced familiar option.

Special: This feat may be selected more than once, but no more than once for every five caster levels you possess.
